name: io.github.Har50/ngtchain
title: NextGen Token
description: Each call spends real NGT or USDC from a wallet you fund, within caps and a session budget.

environmentVariables.name: NGT_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Wallet key that signs NGT payments. Use a dedicated wallet.

environmentVariables.name: NGT_MAX_PRICE
environmentVariables.description: Most one call may pay, in NGT. Default 0.01.

environmentVariables.name: NGT_SESSION_BUDGET
environmentVariables.description: Most pay_and_fetch may spend per server session, in NGT. Default 0.1.

environmentVariables.name: NGT_USDC_MAX_PRICE
environmentVariables.description: Most one call may pay, in USDC on Base. Default 0, which keeps USDC off.

environmentVariables.name: NGT_USDC_SESSION_BUDGET
environmentVariables.description: Most pay_and_fetch may spend per server session, in USDC, separate from the NGT budget. Default 0, which keeps USDC off.

environmentVariables.name: NGT_PREFERRED_CURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Token to pay when a seller takes both NGT and USDC: NGT or USDC. Default NGT.

environmentVariables.name: NGT_MAX_FUNDING
environmentVariables.description: Most one fund_agent_wallet request may ask the user's browser wallet to send, in NGT. Default 10.

environmentVariables.name: NGT_HOST_HEADERS
environmentVariables.description: Headers sent to one host only, as JSON, e.g. {"api.example.com":{"x-api-key":"..."}}. The model never sees them.

environmentVariables.name: NGT_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Folder for the local activity log and the pause flag. Default ~/.ngtchain.
